message: Additional code finding: LedgerBindingConfig.loadAtRootWithSnapshot (Client/Modules/OrchestrationApi.fs lines 139-161) HOLDS the exclusive trust-binding .lock while doing LedgerStore.fetch (remote Git I/O), verifyTrustedHead, and possible writeStored. Concurrent inspectLocal() (lines 186-194) uses the same lock for dashboard grouping; 50*40ms attempts can expire before remote fetch releases lock. Investigate this broad critical section as primary contention mechanism. Fix architecture safely: reduce lock scope / stage fetch outside lock and revalidate under lock, or otherwise isolate nonblocking dashboard reads while preserving monotonic trust-anchor CAS and atomic updates. Add explicit regression with slow fetch + dashboard refresh; do not simply increase retry window.
